problem: A line standing on a straight line produces adjacent angles whose sum is two right angles. The perpendicular case gives two individual right angles.

proof_idea.original: Source uses a perpendicular auxiliary ray and addition/subtraction of adjacent angle magnitudes.
proof_idea.analytic: Derive opposite base-ray vectors from a strict interior base point, then opposite normalized dot products. Principal arccos values sum to pi.

litex_code:
# Book I, Proposition 13: adjacent angles at a strict interior base point sum to two right angles.
# The strict affine parameter makes the base rays opposite; principal radian measures sum to pi.
thm proposition_13:
    ? forall a, b, q, p cart(R, R), t R+:
        a != b
        q != a
        q != b
        p != q
        not $geometry::main::is_collinear(a, b, p)
        t < 1
        q(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))
        q(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))
        =>:
            ray_angle(a, q, p) + ray_angle(p, q, b) = pi
    have x R = b(1) - a(1)
    have y R = b(2) - a(2)
    have u R = p(1) - q(1)
    have v R = p(2) - q(2)
    have n R = x * u + y * v
    a(1) - q(1) = a(1) - (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))) = -t * (b(1) - a(1)) = -t * x
    a(2) - q(2) = a(2) - (a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))) = -t * (b(2) - a(2)) = -t * y
    b(1) - q(1) = b(1) - (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))) = (1 - t) * (b(1) - a(1)) = (1 - t) * x
    b(2) - q(2) = b(2) - (a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))) = (1 - t) * (b(2) - a(2)) = (1 - t) * y
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, q, p) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, a), geometry::main::vec(q, p)) = (a(1) - q(1)) * (p(1) - q(1)) + (a(2) - q(2)) * (p(2) - q(2)) = (-t * x) * u + (-t * y) * v = -t * (x * u + y * v) = -t * n
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = (p(1) - q(1)) * (b(1) - q(1)) + (p(2) - q(2)) * (b(2) - q(2)) = u * ((1 - t) * x) + v * ((1 - t) * y) = (1 - t) * (x * u + y * v) = (1 - t) * n
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(q, p)
    have norm R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p)
    release thm geometry::main::affine_distance_from_parameter(a, b, q, t)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, q, p) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, a) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) = (t^2 * geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) = t^2 * (geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p)) = t^2 * norm
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) * ((1 - t)^2 * geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b)) = (1 - t)^2 * (geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) * geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p)) = (1 - t)^2 * norm
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(a, q, p)
    release thm angles::angle_root_den_nonzero(a, q, p)
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(p, q, b)
    release thm angles::angle_root_den_nonzero(p, q, b)
    have s R+ = 1 - t
    release thm scaled_positive_root_domain(t, norm)
    release thm scaled_positive_root_domain(s, norm)
    release thm opposite_scaled_cosine_cross_products(n, norm, t, s)
    t^2 * norm > 0
    s^2 * norm > 0
    have root_a R+ = sqrt(t^2 * norm)
    have root_b R+ = sqrt(s^2 * norm)
    (-t * n) * root_b = (-t * n) * sqrt(s^2 * norm) = -(s * n) * sqrt(t^2 * norm) = -(s * n) * root_a
    (-t * n) / root_a = ((-t * n) * root_b) / (root_a * root_b) = (-(s * n) * root_a) / (root_a * root_b) = -(s * n) / root_b = -((s * n) / root_b)
    sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, q, p)) = sqrt(t^2 * norm) = root_a
    angles::angle_cosine(a, q, p) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, q, p) / sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, q, p)) = (-t * n) / root_a
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = (1 - t) * n = s * n
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = (1 - t)^2 * norm = s^2 * norm
    sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)) = sqrt(s^2 * norm) = root_b
    angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) / sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)) = (s * n) / root_b
    angles::angle_cosine(a, q, p) = (-t * n) / root_a = -((s * n) / root_b) = -angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b)
    angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b) = -(-angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b)) = -angles::angle_cosine(a, q, p)
    release thm opposite_cosines_give_supplementary_angles(a, q, p, p, q, b)
